about_desc: Established in 2011, M-Trans LLC operates an 80+ truck fleet and an official spare parts distribution network across the region.
about_title: Your Reliable Heavy Equipment Parts Supplier
about_p1: M-Trans LLC was founded in 2011 as part of the M-Forward group. Alongside operating a fleet of over 80 Euro 5 and Euro 6 trucks, we specialize in supplying 100% genuine OEM spare parts for Volvo, Scania, Mercedes Actros, MAN, and DAF heavy vehicles.
about_p2: We partner directly with world leaders including Knorr-Bremse, WABCO, Hengst, Sachs, and Bosch to guarantee genuine quality and continuous warranty.
about_mission_desc: To deliver 100% original, certified spare parts for heavy equipment and commercial vehicles efficiently and transparently.
about_vision_desc: To be the leading heavy vehicle spare parts supplier in the region, eliminating equipment downtime for our B2B clients.
